proved_properties: IAM role evidence alone does not resolve to a SABOROU userId
Invalid auth evidence does not resolve to a userId
Resolved identity implies Cognito JWT evidence
MCP precheck rejects IAM-role-only requests as unauthorized
Requests without identity cannot pass precheck
Write and external-post tools require approval
Side-effect tools without approval are rejected
Read tool with valid Cognito identity passes precheck
Safe audit event is independent of raw secret and raw args
IAM-role-only audit event has no user hash

spec_alignment.notes: The Lean model formalizes the U-V3-01 security invariants from Functional Design. It does not prove every TypeScript implementation line is bug-free.

residual_risk: Code Generation must preserve the Lean model when translating to TypeScript/CDK.
Future U-V3-02 tool registry implementation must add concrete tool allowlist/schema proofs or tests.
